meta.title: Todo Panel
meta.description: A todo panel that lives on the window's right edge: it sits as a full-height column beside the chat, and one button in its header flips it into a draggable floating card and back. Includes a built-in pomodoro timer (preset or custom focus and break minutes, round count and break interval, announced through system notifications). Create items with a title, details, due time and attachment, grouped by today and more, with a second tab for all items and paged completed ones. The plugin's Host half keeps the data in ~/.dsh/todo-panel/state.json, so it survives restarts.
